data.name: Mario
data.gender_notes: Mario is used as a male name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Roman god of war, Mars, used as a given name in the Christian world. The name Mario carries the meaning “Mars god” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Hebrew, Greek. Parents who choose Mario usually hope their child will grow to embody mars god and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Mario belongs to the Biblical linguistic tradition and is used in Christian naming. Its recorded meaning is “Mars god.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Mario total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.

in_hebrew.name: מריו
in_hebrew.meaning: מריו הוא שם שפירושו מר או ים
in_hebrew.long_meaning: מריו הוא שם שמקורו בשפה העברית ופירושו מר או ים. השם מריו קשור לשם העברי מרים, שפירושו מרה או ים. השם מרים הוזכר בתנ"ך כהשם של אחותו של משה ואהרון. השם מריו משמש כנראה כגרסה משופרת של השם מרים, ומשמש כהשם פרטי בקרב הקהילה הנוצרית.

in_greek.name: Μαρίο
in_greek.meaning: Ο Μαρίο σημαίνει Μάριος ή θαλασσα
in_greek.long_meaning: Ο Μαρίο είναι όνομα που προέρχεται από την ελληνική γλώσσα και σημαίνει Μάριος ή θαλασσα. Το όνομα Μαρίο πιθανόν να συνδέεται με το ελληνικό όνομα Μαρία, που σημαίνει πικρός ή θαλασσα. Στην Καινή Διαθήκη, το όνομα Μαρία αναφέρεται ως το όνομα της μητέρας του Ιησού και της αδελφής του Λάζαρου. Το όνομα Μαρίο χρησιμοποιείται ως προσωπικό όνομα στην κοινότητα των Χριστιανών.

in_latin.name: Mario
in_latin.meaning: Mario means bitter or wished-for child
in_latin.long_meaning: Mario is a name derived from Latin and means bitter or wished-for child. The name Mario is likely connected to the Latin name Marius, which means bitter or sea. In early Christian tradition, the name Marius was used to signify a person who was devoted to the Virgin Mary. The name Mario has been used across various Christian cultures as a personal name.

in_english.name: Mario
in_english.meaning: Mario means bitter or sea, a wished-for child
in_english.long_meaning: The name Mario originates from the Hebrew name Miriam, meaning bitter or sea. It was popularized through the Latin name Marius, signifying bitter or wished-for child. In Christian tradition, Mario is associated with devotion to the Virgin Mary. Historically, the name Mario has been used across various cultures, symbolizing strength and spiritual dedication. The name Mario conveys a sense of purpose and divine blessing.

data.cultural_impact: Marianne D confesses her love for the Mario video game franchise, founded in 1981 by Nintendo. This series has transcended basic entertainment to become a significant cultural phenomenon. The main character, Mario, is a symbol of heroism, perseverance, and determination.
data.spiritual_significance: The name Mario has deep spiritual roots, as it stems from the ancient Roman god Mars, the deity of war. In Christian contexts, the name may symbolically represent a warrior of faith, inspiring those with this name to face challenges with courage and unwavering commitment to their beliefs.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Mario, derived from the Latin Marius, means "bitter" or "rebellious," yet in Christianity, it symbolizes the transformative power of God, turning bitterness into devotion and rebellion into submission. Or, Mario, meaning "little mariner" in Italian origin, can symbolically represent the Christian's journey through life, navigating stormy seas and uncharted waters with faith and trust in God's guidance.

historical_references.reference: Mario of Sicily, also known as Saint Marius of Averna, was a bishop and abbot who lived in the 11th century. He is best known for his miraculous healing of a leper, which led to the foundation of a monastery in his honor.

Mario Savio was a student activist and leader during the Free Speech Movement at the University of California, Berkeley in the late 1960s. He is remembered for his famous quote 'There is a time when the operation of the machine becomes so odious, makes you so sick at heart, that you can't take part! And you've got to put your bodies upon the gears and upon the wheels, upon the levers, upon all the apparatus, and you've got to make it stop! And you've got to indicate to the people who run it, to the people who own it, that unless you're free, the machine will be prevented from working at all!', which became a rallying cry for the civil rights movement in the US.

modern_usage.modern_context: The Christian name 'Mario' is most notably recognized as the main character in the 'Mario' video game franchise, which started in the late 1980s. Today, Mario has become a cultural phenomenon, transcending its original platform as a video game character. The 'Mario' franchise has expanded to various media, including the Gaming Industry (Nintendo Switch, Super Nintendo Entertainment System, PlayStation, etc.), Pop Culture (movies, TV shows, music, etc.), and Merchandise (toys, clothing, collectibles, etc.). Mario's popularity is evident in his presence on multiple gaming platforms, such as the Super Nintendo Entertainment System, PlayStation, and iOS. The character's enduring appeal is a testament to the evolution of video games and their integration into mainstream culture.
